subject.title: feat(feeds): serve signed catalog queries and changes

question: May `/api/v1/feeds/plugins` replace the existing raw catalog document with a DSSE-only response that fails closed until the signing secret is provisioned, or must signed delivery use a compatibility transition?
rationale: The patch changes an existing public route and ties its availability to a new operator-managed signing secret; tests cannot determine the intended upgrade contract for existing consumers.

options.title: Stage signed delivery separately
options.body: Keep the raw route compatible and expose DSSE through a versioned or explicitly negotiated representation until consumers and signer provisioning are confirmed.

options.title: Approve a direct DSSE cutover
options.body: Accept the route replacement only with an explicit operator rollout, public-key/consumer transition plan, and live proof that all supported consumers handle the new representation.

recommendation.title: Stage signed delivery separately
recommendation.body: Keep the raw route compatible and expose DSSE through a versioned or explicitly negotiated representation until consumers and signer provisioning are confirmed.

likelyOwner.reason: The available related-review context points to prior feed-contract involvement, although repository history evidence is limited.
